method.time_files: JSON loading + native extraction/indexing + evaluate + accumulate + summarize
method.time_in_memory: GT indexing + prediction dictionary copies + result loading + evaluate + accumulate + summarize; excludes JSON parsing
method.exclusions: Inference and output serialization are outside scoring time
method.repeats: Three fresh processes per version/workload, alternating version order; no filesystem cache eviction
method.native_timings: Diagnostic phase counters are not additive wall times; extraction counters cover Python-list extraction only, and evaluation phase counters are summed across categories
